name: Bound
description: An enclosing structural band represents a protected space with an intentional opening. Midnight and gold establish a firm, attentive tone. The C-like contour is a recognition risk: it is not a hidden NIVRA initial. The A crossbar was restored in refinement.

name: Passage
description: A compact N uses alternating rounded and square outer corners around a diagonal passage. It ties the mark to NIVRA's name without forcing an eye. The N construction is a familiar category, so no unique-recognition or trademark claim is made. The earlier swoosh concept was rejected internally and is not included.

name: Ready
description: A wordmark-led identity uses the V/R relationship to create a controlled diagonal passage. The R's stem is partly expressed by this relationship; it must be tested carefully at small sizes during refinement. The name itself carries the identity, without an added icon.
